The '''Lower Gangland''' was a [[plaza]] located in the [[Black Sun territory]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era. The [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate had their [[Black Sun Headquarters|headquarters]] located in the plaza.
